source: FFmpeg 9.0.2 release tarball (sha256 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e), tests/fate/*.mak, lexical search for mpeg1video, mpegts muxing and swscale RGB->YUV
note: Lexical identities, classified before execution. None maps to the selected capture operation, so none was run; the predeclared native comparisons in contract.json are the correctness evidence. FATE identities are not tests executed.

cases.operation: mpeg1video encode at fixed -qscale 10 of vsynth sources; bitstream md5 + decode PSNR against FFmpeg's own output
cases.reason: the captured application never runs fixed-qscale mode (bitrate/maxrate/bufsize rate control, contract encoder.bit_rate); and the reference value is FFmpeg's own byte-exact bitstream, which an independent encoder is not required to reproduce (docs/testing.md Encoder row).
B pictures and packet-size slicing are not enabled by the captured application (bf 0).

cases.operation: MPEG-2 video + MP2 audio into mpegts with transport_stream_id 42
cases.reason: Two streams, MPEG-2 video and audio; capture muxes one MPEG-1 video stream with default identifiers.

cases.operation: seeking in the vsynth mpeg1 outputs
self-tests of swscale's new ops backend
cases.reason: Internal consistency checks of a different swscale code path; capture uses the legacy sws_getContext/sws_scale RGBA->NV12 path, compared directly instead.
